title: Odd single-part peak elements freely generate the K-theoretic peak algebra over Z beta
difficulty: The proof derives deformed peak-product coefficients and a relation eliminating even single-part generators, then builds two different triangular bases and an explicit bijection from peak to odd compositions. Integral unitriangularity establishes freeness without localization; this is a uniform algebra presentation, not a numerical specialization.
scope: The selected problem is the author Proposition4.11 (source label MPeak-free-prop), the exact integral Z[beta]-algebra free generation by odd single-part multipeak elements. Full introductory and local Sections2--4.2 up to this complete proof retain the Hopf/dual product construction, five-term deformed peak product, even-generator elimination, both triangular bases and peak-to-odd composition bijection. Later shifted tableaux, antipodes and positivity are unselected.
